title: Nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds with the same homotopy type
main_claim: There exist closed aspherical topological 4-manifolds M and N, with a common word-hyperbolic fundamental group, that are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic. Also, M has a self-homotopy equivalence that is not homotopic to any homeomorphism.

issues.location: Sec. 3, Theorem 3.1 (refl:input) and its use in Prop. 3.4 / Prop. 4.3
issues.description: Load-bearing dependency rather than a demonstrated gap. The step 'a closed 4-manifold model of the reflection gives a marked filling of S' is described as 'extracted from the proof in [PD, Sections 3-5]'; it is not a stated theorem of PD. The odd-cover non-filling (Prop. 9.1) imports MT Prop. 4.5, Thm. 5.1 and Lemmas 6.3-6.6 unchanged. Together these imply results far beyond the state of the art (for example, that free groups are not good), so the whole paper stands or falls with those companion papers.
issues.evidence: reflection.tex: 'The following statement is extracted from the proof in \cite[Sections~3--5]{PD}.' formal.tex: 'The edge results are imported unchanged from \cite[Proposition~4.5 and Theorem~5.1]{MT}.' Within this paper, every use of these inputs matches their stated hypotheses: chamber data lift to every cyclic cover (Lemma ch:cover-data), L_d is flag, and the finite cover hat Q_d -> Q^0_d -> Q_d exists.

coverage:
I checked the following parts in detail and found them correct:
- Cyclic-cover criterion (Thm 2.1): the exact lift u, commutation h'T = Th', the proper height function, the free cocompact action of F_r, and pi1(Y_r) = K x_{Ad gamma^{2r+1}} Z = G_{2r+1}.
- Sylow criterion (Prop 2.3).
- Rigid relations (Lemma 4.1): weights 16*sum 2^i - 2r(J) are all distinct, and the vertex count 4072 is right.
- Quotient covering and the odd-cover transfer (Prop 4.3).
- Doubled-chamber manifold charts and the homotopy-pushout equivalence (Prop 4.5).
- Equivariance of T_a^eps with the graph subgroups.
- E -> Aut(Pi): faithful, with full preimages.
- Non-conjugacy of A and B_l, by counting elements with finite-order lifts.
- delta not in R_M, via the cyclic criterion with gamma = (1, h).
- Grid bound n <= 16 b_T - 1 (the four-cycle label analysis and the no-induced-square step), and grids -> thin triangles in the median graph.
- No splitting over virtually cyclic groups, via the path cocycle, PD H^1 = H_3, Shapiro, and H_3(Z) = 0; then Bestvina-Feighn gives Out(Pi) finite.
- RACG generator rigidity and the star/link conjugator synchronization; the normalizer computation N(A) = A x <delta>.
- Even-cover filling, by red/blue port selection and surgery of S^2 x S^2 pieces.
- Odd-cycle deficient-color argument (Cor. 8.2).
- Linear cut-data lemma (coordinate line, plus/minus endpoints).

I skimmed but did not verify: the tensor endpoint-assignment proof (Sec. 8.2 onward), the formal-data assembly (Sec. 9.3 onward), the chamber Poincaré-pair construction, and the imported MT/PD results.
